snippet.title: Remnant Records - Launch Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Remnant Records will be available in 1.0 on January 23th 2024 on Steam. 

Remnant Records is a horror investigation game for 1 to 4 players. 
Pick your role and skills, investigate haunted places alone or with friends, survive & exorcise uniques ghosts.

Check the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1916310/Remnant_Records/
X: https://twitter.com/remnant_records
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/Uf8EpWsFts
